detail: In stata_recode() (alias recode()), 1:2 is the closed range 1 <= x <= 2, including decimals, like 1/2 in Stata. The first matching rule wins. .default = NA plays the role of else = .; without it, unmatched values are kept, as in Stata.
detail_zh: 在 stata_recode()（别名 recode()）中，1:2 表示闭区间 1 <= x <= 2（含小数），相当于 Stata 的 1/2。按第一条匹配的规则重编码。.default = NA 相当于 else = .；不指定时保留未匹配的取值，与 Stata 相同。
setup: data <- data.frame(id=1:6, g=c(1,1,2,2,3,3), x=c(1,2,NA,4,5,6), y=c(2,4,6,8,10,12), s=c(" a ","B","c","a","",NA), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

detail_zh: 未匹配的取值（包括缺失值）保持不变。规则与原始取值比较，因此 stata_recode(x, 1 ~ 2, 2 ~ 1) 可交换代码。NA ~ 0 重编码缺失值，相当于 (missing = 0)。
setup: data <- data.frame(id=1:6, g=c(1,1,2,2,3,3), x=c(1,2,NA,4,5,6), y=c(2,4,6,8,10,12), s=c(" a ","B","c","a","",NA), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

task_zh: 随机分配均衡的两半样本

task_zh: 将完整数值行复制为矩阵

task_zh: 将矩阵转换为具名数据列

task: Save a temporary on-disk data snapshot
task_zh: 将数据快照临时保存到磁盘
detail: Uses an RDS file path rather than Stata's numbered interactive snapshot manager.
detail_zh: 使用 RDS 文件路径，代替 Stata 带编号的交互快照管理器。

task: Restore a temporary data snapshot
task_zh: 恢复临时数据快照
detail: Restores an explicitly supplied RDS path rather than a numbered Stata snapshot.
detail_zh: 恢复显式指定的 RDS 文件，而非 Stata 编号快照。

task: Build a many-to-one row link to a lookup table
task_zh: 创建指向查找表的多对一行链接
detail: R match indices are a snapshot and must be rebuilt after lookup row reordering.
detail_zh: R match 行号是快照；查找表行序改变后须重新创建。
meaning: frlink: Build a many-to-one row link to a lookup table

task: Validate and construct a one-to-one table link
task_zh: 验证并创建一对一数据表链接
detail: link is a fixed R object name; unmatched keys produce NA. Rebuild after source changes.
detail_zh: link 是本例固定 R 对象名；未匹配键产生 NA。源表改变后需重建。
meaning: frlink: Validate and construct a one-to-one table link

task: Copy a value through an established table link
task_zh: 通过已有表链接复制数值
detail: Copies values using the precomputed link. Stata display formats and metadata require explicit copying in R.
detail_zh: 通过预先计算的链接复制值；Stata 显示格式与元数据在 R 中需显式复制。
setup: data <- data.frame(id=c(2,1,9),x=c(20,10,90)); lookup <- data.frame(id=1:2,score=c(100,200)); data$link <- match(data$id,lookup$id)
meaning: frget: Copy a value through an established table link

task: Rename a linked value when copying it
task_zh: 复制链接值时重命名

setup: data <- data.frame(id=c(2,1,9),x=c(20,10,90)); lookup <- data.frame(id=1:2,score=c(100,200)); data$link <- match(data$id,lookup$id)
meaning: frget: Rename a linked value when copying it

task: Read linked values dynamically without storing a copied column
task_zh: 动态读取链接值而不保存复制列

detail_zh: R 访问函数流程，不是别名列：每次调用 get_score()；修改应在 lookup 中进行。
meaning: fralias: Read linked values dynamically without storing a copied column

task: Materialize a dynamically looked-up value as a column
task_zh: 将动态查找值实体化为列
detail: Materialize an ordinary R column snapshot. Requires data and lookup tables with matching id keys and a lookup score column; later lookup changes do not change this column.
detail_zh: 将查询结果保存为普通 R 列快照。需要 data 和 lookup 两张表，具有匹配的 id 键及 lookup 中的 score 列；后续修改 lookup 不会改变该列。
setup: data <- data.frame(id=c(2,1,9),x=c(20,10,90)); lookup <- data.frame(id=1:2,score=c(100,200)); get_score <- function() lookup$score[match(data$id,lookup$id)]
meaning: frunalias: Materialize a dynamically looked-up value as a column

detail_zh: 返回自 1960 年起的普通 Stata %tc 毫秒数，而非 POSIXct 对象。
meaning: cofd: Convert R dates to Stata midnight millisecond codes

task: Extract the hour from a UTC timestamp
task_zh: 从 UTC 时间戳提取小时
detail: Input is an R POSIXct timestamp; convert raw Stata %tc numbers before extracting components.
detail_zh: 输入为 R POSIXct 时间戳；原始 Stata %tc 数值需先转换再提取。
meaning: hh: Extract the hour from a UTC timestamp

task: Extract the minute from a UTC timestamp
task_zh: 从 UTC 时间戳提取分钟
detail: Input is an R POSIXct timestamp; uppercase %M means minute and lowercase %m means month.
detail_zh: 输入为 R POSIXct 时间戳；大写 %M 为分钟，小写 %m 为月份。
meaning: mm: Extract the minute from a UTC timestamp

task: Extract seconds from a UTC timestamp
task_zh: 从 UTC 时间戳提取秒
detail: Input is an R POSIXct timestamp; fractional-second precision depends on the platform and display settings.
detail_zh: 输入为 R POSIXct 时间戳；小数秒精度依赖平台与显示设置。
meaning: ss: Extract seconds from a UTC timestamp

task: Collapse group means using the gcollapse workflow
task_zh: 按 gcollapse 流程汇总组均值
setup: data <- data.frame(id=1:6, g=c(1,1,2,2,3,3), x=c(1,2,NA,4,5,6), y=c(2,4,6,8,10,12), s=c(" a ","B","c","a","",NA), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
meaning: gcollapse: Collapse group means using the gcollapse workflow

task: Collapse group missing-value counts
task_zh: 汇总各组缺失值数
setup: data <- data.frame(id=1:6, g=c(1,1,2,2,3,3), x=c(1,2,NA,4,5,6), y=c(2,4,6,8,10,12), s=c(" a ","B","c","a","",NA), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
meaning: gcollapse: Collapse group missing-value counts

task: Collapse group distinct-value counts on complete data
task_zh: 在完整数据中汇总各组不同值数
detail: Complete values in this fixture; treatment of missing categories is not asserted.
detail_zh: 本例取值完整；不声称缺失类别的处理一致。
meaning: gcollapse: Collapse group distinct-value counts on complete data

task: Add collapsed group means back to all original rows
task_zh: 将汇总组均值附回全部原始行
setup: data <- data.frame(id=1:6, g=c(1,1,2,2,3,3), x=c(1,2,NA,4,5,6), y=c(2,4,6,8,10,12), s=c(" a ","B","c","a","",NA), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
meaning: gcollapse: Add collapsed group means back to all original rows

task: Keep raw group row counts beside collapsed means
task_zh: 在汇总均值旁保留组原始行数
setup: data <- data.frame(id=1:6, g=c(1,1,2,2,3,3), x=c(1,2,NA,4,5,6), y=c(2,4,6,8,10,12), s=c(" a ","B","c","a","",NA), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
meaning: gcollapse: Keep raw group row counts beside collapsed means

stata: greshape gather x1 x2, keys(measure) values(value)
task: Gather explicitly named wide columns with greshape
task_zh: 使用 greshape 收集明确指定的宽格式列
meaning: greshape: Gather explicitly named wide columns with greshape

task: Spread text-keyed values into columns with greshape
task_zh: 使用 greshape 将文本键值展开为列
meaning: greshape: Spread text-keyed values into columns with greshape

stata: greshape long x, by(id) keys(wave) dropmiss
task: Drop missing measurements while reshaping one stub
task_zh: 转换单个前缀时删除缺失测量行
detail: Single-stub fixed workflow; for multiple stubs drop a row only when every reshaped value is missing.
detail_zh: 固定单前缀流程；多前缀仅在所有转换值均缺失时删除该行。
meaning: greshape: Drop missing measurements while reshaping one stub

task: Collapse means with the ftools public helper
task_zh: 使用 ftools 公共辅助命令汇总均值
setup: data <- data.frame(id=1:6, g=c(1,1,2,2,3,3), x=c(1,2,NA,4,5,6), y=c(2,4,6,8,10,12), s=c(" a ","B","c","a","",NA), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
meaning: fcollapse: Collapse means with the ftools public helper

task: Merge fcollapse group summaries back into original rows
task_zh: 将 fcollapse 组汇总值附回原始行
setup: data <- data.frame(id=1:6, g=c(1,1,2,2,3,3), x=c(1,2,NA,4,5,6), y=c(2,4,6,8,10,12), s=c(" a ","B","c","a","",NA), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
meaning: fcollapse: Merge fcollapse group summaries back into original rows

task: Preserve missing for entirely missing group sums
task_zh: 组内全缺失时保留缺失总和
meaning: fcollapse: Preserve missing for entirely missing group sums

task: Perform a validated ftools-style one-to-one merge
task_zh: 执行已验证的 ftools 风格一对一合并
detail: Requires disjoint non-key column names unless update is explicitly shown. dplyr suffixes overlapping names; ordinary Stata merge preserves master values, including master missing values, on matched rows.
detail_zh: 除非明确展示 update，非键列名需互不重复。dplyr 会为重名列添加后缀；普通 Stata merge 在匹配行保留主表取值，包括主表缺失值。
meaning: fmerge: Perform a validated ftools-style one-to-one merge

task: Store observed categories from the ftools levels helper
task_zh: 通过 ftools 类别辅助命令保存非缺失类别
setup: data <- data.frame(id=1:6, g=c(1,1,2,2,3,3), x=c(1,2,NA,4,5,6), y=c(2,4,6,8,10,12), s=c(" a ","B","c","a","",NA), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
meaning: flevelsof: Store observed categories from the ftools levels helper

task: Inspect the R data-manipulation package version and availability
task_zh: 查看 R 数据操作包版本与可用性
detail: Reports the chosen R workflow dependency, dplyr; it does not inspect or compile a Stata Mata library.
detail_zh: 报告所选 R 流程依赖 dplyr；不检查或编译 Stata Mata 库。
meaning: ftools: Inspect the R data-manipulation package version and availability

task: Require an installed R workflow dependency
task_zh: 要求 R 流程依赖已安装
detail: Checks the R counterpart dependency dplyr; no package is installed and Stata package names do not translate automatically.
detail_zh: 检查 R 对应依赖 dplyr；不安装包，Stata 包名也不自动转换。
meaning: require: Require an installed R workflow dependency

task: Require a minimum version of an R workflow dependency
task_zh: 要求 R 流程依赖达到最低版本
detail: The R counterpart has its own version requirement; 1.1.0 supports the .by and relationship features used in these examples.
detail_zh: R 对应包有独立的版本要求；1.1.0 支持本组示例使用的 .by 与 relationship 功能。
meaning: require: Require a minimum version of an R workflow dependency

task: Compute a mean over each closed numeric-key neighborhood
task_zh: 在各闭区间数值键邻域内计算均值
detail: Small complete-data workflow with inclusive key offsets and self included; quadratic scanning is not intended for large datasets.
detail_zh: 小型完整数据流程，采用含端点的键偏移并纳入自身；平方复杂度扫描不适合大型数据。
meaning: rangestat: Compute a mean over each closed numeric-key neighborhood

task: Compute a sum over each closed numeric-key neighborhood
task_zh: 在各闭区间数值键邻域内计算总和
detail: Complete finite keys/values only in this fixture; missing bounds, by-groups and weights need explicit extensions.
detail_zh: 本例仅含完整有限键与数值；缺失边界、分组与权重需显式扩展。
meaning: rangestat: Compute a sum over each closed numeric-key neighborhood

task: Exclude the current row from numeric-range means
task_zh: 从数值区间均值中排除当前行
detail: Excludes row identity rather than all tied keys. Every fixture neighborhood has another observation; empty neighborhoods need NA handling.
detail_zh: 排除当前行本身而不是所有相同键；本例每个邻域还有其他观测，空邻域需另设 NA 处理。
meaning: rangestat: Exclude the current row from numeric-range means

task: Cap both tails at explicitly selected empirical quartiles
task_zh: 按显式经验四分位数压缩两端极值
detail: Unweighted workflow with an explicit R type-2 empirical percentile rule; no cross-software numerical certification is claimed.
detail_zh: 非加权流程，显式使用 R type-2 经验百分位规则；不声称已完成跨软件数值认证。
meaning: gstats: Cap both tails at explicitly selected empirical quartiles

stata: gstats winsor x, cuts(25 75) trim generate(z)
r: bounds <- stats::quantile(data$x,c(.25,.75),na.rm=TRUE,type=2); data$z <- data$x; data$z[!is.na(data$x) & (data$x<bounds[1] | data$x>bounds[2])] <- NA_real_
task: Set values outside empirical quartiles to missing
task_zh: 将经验四分位区间外的值设为缺失
detail: Trimming sets tails to missing while retaining rows; percentile rule is explicit R type 2 and no weighted parity is asserted.
detail_zh: 截尾将尾部设为缺失并保留行；百分位规则为 R type 2，不声称加权结果一致。
meaning: gstats: Set values outside empirical quartiles to missing

stata: gstats winsor x, by(g) cuts(25 75) replace
task: Cap tails separately inside each group
task_zh: 在每组内分别压缩极端值
detail: Groups use independent unweighted R type-2 cutoffs; all-missing groups require an explicit policy.
detail_zh: 各组使用独立的非加权 R type-2 阈值；全缺失组需显式规定处理方式。
meaning: gstats: Cap tails separately inside each group

r: { data <- dplyr::arrange(data, id, year); dplyr::mutate(data, first = as.integer(dplyr::row_number() == 1L), .by = id) }
task: Mark the first observation within sorted groups
task_zh: 标记排序后各组的首个观测
detail: Sorts by id and year, then marks one first row per id, including a missing-id group. Ties in year use input order in R; add a tie-break variable for a reproducible cross-system choice.
detail_zh: 先按id和year排序，再在每个id中标记首行，包括id缺失组。R按输入顺序处理相同year；如需跨软件可复现的选择，应加入打破并列的变量。
meaning: mark the first observation within sorted groups

task: Create the empirical cumulative distribution of a variable
task_zh: 生成变量的经验累积分布
detail: Missing values stay missing and are excluded from the denominator. By default Stata gives tied values distinct cumulatives in an arbitrary order; R breaks ties by row order. Weights and by() need an explicit grouped or weighted version.
detail_zh: 缺失值仍为缺失，且不计入分母。Stata 默认对相同取值按任意顺序赋予不同的累积值，R 按行顺序处理相同取值。权重及 by() 需另行按组或加权计算。
setup: data <- data.frame(id=1:6, g=c(1,1,2,2,3,3), x=c(1,2,NA,4,5,6), y=c(2,4,6,8,10,12), s=c(" a ","B","c","a","",NA), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
meaning: cumul: Create the empirical cumulative distribution of a variable

task: Cumulative distribution with equal values for ties
task_zh: 相同取值共享累积值的经验累积分布
detail: Tied values share the largest cumulative proportion, as ecdf(x)(x) does; missing values stay missing.
detail_zh: 相同取值共享最大的累积比例，与 ecdf(x)(x) 相同；缺失值仍为缺失。
meaning: cumul: Cumulative distribution with equal values for ties

task: Create indicator variables omitting the lowest category
task_zh: 生成省略最低类别的虚拟变量
detail: Keeps the original columns and omits the first observed category. Numeric categories are ordered by value; R factors follow their level order, which must match Stata's omitted category. Stata names indicators by category code; R numbers observed categories with .names="index". Use factor(g) in models; xi: interactions are not reproduced.
detail_zh: 保留原有列，并省略首个已观测类别。数值类别按取值排序；R 因子按水平顺序排列，须使其与 Stata 的省略类别一致。Stata 按类别代码命名虚拟变量，R 通过 .names="index" 按已观测类别编号。建模时使用 factor(g)；不复现 xi: 交互展开。
setup: data <- data.frame(id=1:6, g=c(1,1,2,2,3,3), x=c(1,2,NA,4,5,6), y=c(2,4,6,8,10,12), s=c(" a ","B","c","a","",NA), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
meaning: xi: Create indicator variables omitting the lowest category

task: Save the data as an SPSS file
task_zh: 将数据保存为 SPSS 文件
detail: Community command. haven writes variable and value labels, but rejects Stata tagged missing values (.a, .b) with an error. Convert them explicitly to ordinary NA or to chosen SPSS user-missing codes with haven::labelled_spss() before writing. String widths and display formats may differ.
detail_zh: 社区命令。haven 会写出变量标签和值标签，但遇到 Stata 标签缺失值（.a、.b）会报错。写出前须明确将其转换为普通 NA，或通过 haven::labelled_spss() 转换为选定的 SPSS 用户缺失代码。字符串宽度和显示格式也可能不同。
check: back <- haven::read_sav(path); stopifnot(identical(as.numeric(back$x), c(1, 2, 1, NA)), identical(attr(back$x, 'label'), 'Response'), identical(unname(attr(back$x, 'labels')), c(1, 2)))
meaning: savespss: Save the data as an SPSS file
